description: The VP of Baseball leads baseball operations across GNGRLL's player-pitch divisions (AA ages 7-8, AAA Minors ages 9-10, Majors ages 11-12, and Juniors/Seniors ages 13-16), coordinating with the president, coaching coordinator, and scheduler. Responsibilities run year-round: publishing game and practice schedules in GameChanger, running spring indoor/clinic practices, organizing division playoffs with brackets and rules, standing up summer baseball, and managing Junior/Senior commitment letters and rosters. The VP works closely with the softball VP, umpire-in-chief, and safety officer to keep the on-field program balanced, competitive, and fun for kids across all levels.

calendar.title: Junior & Senior baseball commitment letters due
calendar.description: Collect Junior & Senior baseball commitment responses (due Nov 30) and publish the roster by Nov 1 so summer-season Junior/Senior teams can be planned early in the FY.

calendar.title: Spring indoor practice / clinic schedule set
calendar.description: Finalize the clinic-style indoor practice schedule (gym/YMCA time slots, Saturday sessions into April) for AA/AAA/Majors, coordinating coaches and pooled stations before teams move to the fields.

calendar.title: Draft complete - build team practice/game schedules
calendar.description: With drafts done and teams finalized, work with coaches and the scheduler to lay out division practice and game schedules ahead of the season start (approx. April 10).

calendar.title: Game & practice schedules posted in GameChanger
calendar.description: Publish and update AA/AAA/Majors baseball (and coordinate Tee Ball/Coach Pitch/Softball) practice and game schedules in GameChanger with correct start dates, fields, and times.

calendar.title: Playoff schedule, rules & brackets announcement
calendar.description: Send the league-wide baseball playoff email covering the schedule by division, seeding/home-team rules, pitch-count regulations, AA player-pitch clarifications, and bracket formats (single vs double elimination). See playoffs_tournament__baseball-playoff-schedule-rules.md.

calendar.title: Summer baseball registration & season setup
calendar.description: Open summer baseball / summer-ball registration and set up the summer season (divisions, rosters, schedules) as the regular season wraps into playoffs.

calendar.title: Season retrospective - baseball divisions
calendar.description: Review the post-season survey and division feedback for baseball (AA/AAA/Majors/Juniors/Seniors) to feed next-year rule, structure, and scheduling planning.

tasks.title: Publish Junior & Senior baseball roster by Nov 1
tasks.description: Send Junior & Senior baseball commitment letters, collect responses (due Nov 30), and publish the confirmed roster by Nov 1 so summer-team formation can begin early in the fiscal year.

tasks.title: Rules / division review for baseball
tasks.description: Contribute to the annual rules and division review (farm system, coach-pitch/player-pitch transition, age structure, playing-up) so baseball division rules are set before assessments and drafts.

tasks.title: Book spring indoor practice time and schedule
tasks.description: Secure gym/YMCA time and build the clinic-style indoor practice schedule for AA/AAA/Majors, coordinating coaches, assistant coaches, and volunteer setup crews for nets and bins.

tasks.title: Coordinate post-draft practice/game schedule build
tasks.description: After the draft and coaches meeting, work with the scheduler and coaches to finalize the baseball practice and game calendar leading into opening day (approx. April 10).

tasks.title: Enter and update baseball schedules in GameChanger
tasks.description: Ensure AA/AAA/Majors coaches have entered practice and game schedules in GameChanger with correct start dates, fields, and times, and post league updates for families.

tasks.title: Prepare baseball playoff schedule, brackets & rules
tasks.description: Draw first-round matchups, build brackets (single vs double elimination by division), assemble the pitch-count and playoff rules summary, and coordinate the end-of-season BBQ / Home Run Derby with the president.

tasks.title: Send baseball playoff schedule/rules email
tasks.description: Distribute the league-wide 'Baseball Playoff Schedule, Rules, & Brackets' announcement using the playoffs_tournament template with placeholders for dates, formats, distances, and the pitch-count link filled in.

tasks.title: Launch summer baseball registration and season
tasks.description: Open summer baseball / summer-ball registration, set divisions and team counts, and stand up schedules and rosters for the summer program following the regular season.

tasks.title: Baseball season retrospective input
tasks.description: Review end-of-season survey results and division feedback for baseball and summarize what went well / what to change for next year's structure, scheduling, and rules.
